events.title: HIGH THREAT ZONE!
events.summary: A new area has been added to the demo map. This is a experimental new zone where enemies scale like crazy and have increased essence drop rate!Hold the threat zone to increase essence gain and enemy scaling as tiers go up! Enemies in the threat zone are gold, and crazy!

events.title: Next Fest & New Demo Map
events.summary: Hello BLIGHTFALL people!The demo map has been entirely rebuilt! BLIGHTFALL will be in the October 19–26 Steam Next Fest!There have been some major performance improvements shipped!My focus recently has been on building new maps and bosses! Here's a small preview of Ashfall & the new boss Grim!Thank you everyone for playing, you can reach me directly anytime in the discord!

events.title: Experimental PvP and Lobby Browser
events.summary: Experimental PvP! Lobby browser! Mark your lobbies as public and others can join! In progress joins not supported!

events.title: 3 new items targeting the new sticky grenade!
events.summary: Plasma Bandolier (Epic) +1 grenade charge per stack.Quickfuse (Uncommon) Grenades recharge 15% faster per stack.Slipstream (Rare) Dash recharges 15% faster per stack.Increased sticky grenade throw speed / unequip speed

events.title: BLIGHTFALL Playtest is Live!
events.summary: The first wave of BLIGHTFALL Playtest invitations has been sent out!I'll be inviting more players regularly as I improve the game and fix issues.If you've been accepted, I'd love to hear your feedback on gameplay, balance, performance, and any bugs you encounter.Join the Discord to report bugs, share feedback, and suggest features you'd like to see added!https://discord.gg/bxQx4j58VqIf you haven't requested access yet, you can do so from the store page. More invitations will be sent out soon.Tha
